text:
deploybot: post-deploy checks finished for rollout v3.2.1 -> eu1 canary: failing health check (short-embed probe), p95 up, overall success rate degraded. other regions nominal. tagging @eng-sre for visibility

elaine: saw the alert, pulling dashboards now

chao: looking at logs for inference-proxy in eu1, seeing repeated cache miss churn during steady traffic

sre-oncall: tails show lots of `CacheWarmupError: kv warmup timeout` from the model cache process, followed by retries piling up. not 500s yet but latencies spike to ~400-700ms for a subset of requests

manu: can we isolate to the model variant? which model was rolled to eu1 canary?

deploybot: canary details: traffic=2%, model=redwood/open-r3-quant, variant=r3-2026-02, instance-type=gpu-a2-small

kai: hmm r3-2026-02 has slightly different init sequence for KV prefetch. might explain warmup timing. suggestion: pin eu1 to r3-2026-01 while we investigate. pin would be regional and can be reverted fast

elaine: current numbers: error rate ~0.7% (short-embed probe), p95 from 120ms -> 480ms, tail CPU for pods spikes to 85% during warmup windows. Not seeing increased 5xx in frontend yet.

chao: minimal stack snippet if helpful:
```
2026-03-19T08:12:03Z ERROR CacheWarmupError: timed out after 15s
  at prefiller.fill (/srv/inference/cache/prefill.js:87:23)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```

sre-oncall: workaround options:
- roll back model variant in eu1 to previous (fast but blunt)
- pin traffic for eu1 to previous variant (regional safe)
- increase canary ramp delay and add warmup job before routing traffic

manu: prefer pin-only for now. rollback is noisy for customers if we flip regions. pin + restart prefiller service in eu1 to force healthy caches.

kai: agree with pin. also recommend aborting further rollout to eu2 until we confirm prefiller fix.

deploybot: action commands ready: `redwoodctl pin --region eu1 --model r3-2026-01 --reason "canary warmup regressions"` and `redwoodctl halt-rollout --stage eu --reason "investigating eu1 warmup"`

elaine: @chao can you run the pin and then a rolling restart of the prefiller pods? I'll monitor metrics and re-run short-embed probe after 5m

chao: running pin now -> `OK: pinned eu1 to r3-2026-01 (ticket #INC-4221)`

chao: restarting prefiller deployment: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prefiller-eu1`

sre-oncall: prefiller restart succeeded, pods back up (3/3)

elaine: probe re-run at +5m: short-embed success -> 99.8%, p95 back to ~130ms. CPU tails normalized.

manu: nice. marking as "hold" for wider rollout. we'll keep canary blocked for eu until we root cause small warmup regression in r3-2026-02.

kai: I'll open follow-up: investigate prefetch heuristics change in r3-2026-02 and add unit/regression test for prefiller timing. tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime.

deploybot: rollout state updated: eu paused, note added to release notes draft: "eu canary temporarily pinned due to KV warmup timing; investigating model variant init behavior" :memo:

elaine: thanks all. will close the incident if metrics stay stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
